 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene tteokSceneV9"><div class="tteokAwning"></div><div class="tteokShopSign">1884 전통 떡집</div><div class="backShelf"><div class="tteokTray" style="left:7%;right:54%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokTray" style="left:54%;right:7%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="left:11%;top:36px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="left:25%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="left:39%;top:37px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="right:36%;top:35px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="right:22%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="right:9%;top:37px"></div></div><div class="marketCounter"></div><div class="malletShadowV9"></div><div class="mortarWrap"><div class="mortar"></div><div class="dough" id="dough"></div></div><div class="mortarImpactV9" id="impact"></div><div class="tteokHammer" id="mallet"><div class="woodHammerHead"></div><div class="woodHammerHandle"></div><div class="hammerGrip"></div></div><div class="rhythmTarget" id="target"></div><div class="rhythmRing" id="ring"></div><img class="tteokMascotV9" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="tteokSpeed" id="tteokSpeed">속도 ×1.00</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">연속 성공 COMBO · 5콤보마다 강한 피드백!</div><div class="feverWrap"><div class="feverFill" id="feverFill"></div></div><div class="feverText" id="feverText">찰기 0%</div><div class="tteokGrade" id="grade"></div><button class="tteokHitButton" id="hitBtn">쿵! 떡메 내리치기</button>`;

 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,raf,prev=performance.now();
 let phase=0,combo=0,fever=0,feverTime=0,level=1;

 const ring=$('#ring'),mallet=$('#mallet'),dough=$('#dough'),
       grade=$('#grade'),impact=$('#impact'),scene=$('.tteokSceneV9'),
       target=$('#target');

 // 판정 구간은 레벨/콤보와 무관하게 끝까지 동일.
 const PERFECT_WINDOW=.10;
 const GREAT_WINDOW=.25;
 const GOOD_WINDOW=.46;

 // 난이도 상승은 오직 수축 속도만 변화.
 // LEVEL + COMBO가 오르면 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴이 점점 빨라진다.
 function speedNow(){
  return .78 + (level-1)*.10 + Math.min(1.30, combo*.045);
 }

 function hud(){
  $('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;
  $('#feverFill').style.width=fever+'%';
  $('#feverText').textContent=feverTime>0?`🔥 FEVER ${feverTime.toFixed(1)}s`:`찰기 ${Math.floor(fever)}%`;
  $('#tteokSpeed').textContent=`속도 ×${(speedNow()/.78).toFixed(2)}`;
 }

 function nextBeat(){
  phase=0;
  // 언제나 같은 초록 타깃, 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴.
  target.style.borderColor='#53be6a';
 }

/* tteok - detailed pieces + real impact + level patterns */
function playTteok(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene tteokSceneV9"><div class="tteokAwning"></div><div class="tteokShopSign">1884 전통 떡집</div><div class="backShelf"><div class="tteokTray" style="left:7%;right:54%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokTray" style="left:54%;right:7%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="left:11%;top:36px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="left:25%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="left:39%;top:37px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="right:36%;top:35px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="right:22%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="right:9%;top:37px"></div></div><div class="marketCounter"></div><div class="malletShadowV9"></div><div class="mortarWrap"><div class="mortar"></div><div class="dough" id="dough"></div></div><div class="mortarImpactV9" id="impact"></div><div class="tteokHammer" id="mallet"><div class="woodHammerHead"></div><div class="woodHammerHandle"></div><div class="hammerGrip"></div></div><div class="rhythmTarget" id="target"></div><div class="rhythmRing" id="ring"></div><img class="tteokMascotV9" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="tteokSpeed" id="tteokSpeed">속도 ×1.00</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">연속 성공 COMBO · 5콤보마다 강한 피드백!</div><div class="feverWrap"><div class="feverFill" id="feverFill"></div></div><div class="feverText" id="feverText">찰기 0%</div><div class="tteokGrade" id="grade"></div><button class="tteokHitButton" id="hitBtn">쿵! 떡메 내리치기</button>`;

 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,raf,prev=performance.now();
 let phase=0,combo=0,fever=0,feverTime=0,level=1;

 const ring=$('#ring'),mallet=$('#mallet'),dough=$('#dough'),
       grade=$('#grade'),impact=$('#impact'),scene=$('.tteokSceneV9'),
       target=$('#target');

 // 판정 구간은 레벨/콤보와 무관하게 끝까지 동일.
 const PERFECT_WINDOW=.10;
 const GREAT_WINDOW=.25;
 const GOOD_WINDOW=.46;

 // 난이도 상승은 오직 수축 속도만 변화.
 // LEVEL + COMBO가 오르면 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴이 점점 빨라진다.
 function speedNow(){
  return .78 + (level-1)*.10 + Math.min(1.30, combo*.045);
 }

 function hud(){
  $('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;
  $('#feverFill').style.width=fever+'%';
  $('#feverText').textContent=feverTime>0?`🔥 FEVER ${feverTime.toFixed(1)}s`:`찰기 ${Math.floor(fever)}%`;
  $('#tteokSpeed').textContent=`속도 ×${(speedNow()/.78).toFixed(2)}`;
 }

 function nextBeat(){
  phase=0;
  // 언제나 같은 초록 타깃, 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴.
  target.style.borderColor='#53be6a';
 }

 function impactFx(q){
  mallet.classList.add('strike');
  dough.classList.remove('hit');void dough.offsetWidth;dough.classList.add('hit');
  impact.classList.remove('show');void impact.offsetWidth;impact.classList.add('show');
  scene.classList.remove('impact');void scene.offsetWidth;scene.classList.add('impact');

  let mr=$('.mortar').getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<(q==='perfect'?11:7);i++){
   let ln=document.createElement('div');
   ln.className='impactLineV9';
   ln.style.left=(mr.left-sr.left+mr.width/2+Math.random()*90-45)+'px';
   ln.style.top=(mr.top-sr.top+25)+'px';
   ln.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.random()*120-60}deg)`;
   s.appendChild(ln);setTimeout(()=>ln.remove(),340);
  }
  tone('thump');
  buzz(q==='perfect'?[50,18,75]:[35,14,48]);
  setTimeout(()=>mallet.classList.remove('strike'),125);
 }

 function hit(){
  if(!alive)return;

  // 링은 항상 바깥(2.75) → 중앙(1.0)으로만 수축.
  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  const d=Math.abs(scale-1);

  let pts=0,label='MISS',color='#d84a43',gain=-9,q='miss';

  if(d<PERFECT_WINDOW){
   pts=58;label='PERFECT!';color='#ff9c00';combo++;gain=22;q='perfect';tone('perfect');
  }else if(d<GREAT_WINDOW){
   pts=36;label='GREAT!';color='#62b64d';combo++;gain=14;q='great';tone('good');
  }else if(d<GOOD_WINDOW){
   pts=18;label='GOOD';color='#4e9ad1';combo++;gain=7;q='good';tone('good');
  }else{
   combo=0;tone('bad');softShake();
  }

  let mult=feverTime>0?2:1;
  pts=(pts+Math.min(35,combo*3))*mult;
  score+=pts;
  fever=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,fever+gain));

  if(fever>=100&&feverTime<=0){
   feverTime=5;
   tone('clear');
   particles(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,'🔥',12);
  }

  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  grade.textContent=feverTime>0&&pts>0?label+' ×2':label;
  grade.style.color=color;
  if(pts>0&&combo>=2){
   showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');
   if(combo%5===0){tone('perfect');buzz([16,7,28])}
  }
  grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');

  impactFx(q);
  level=updateLevel('tteok',score,level);
  nextBeat();
  hud();
 }

 $('#hitBtn').onclick=hit;
 s.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.target.id!=='hitBtn')hit()};

  if(!alive)return;
  let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)

function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;

 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}

function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;

 return null
}

}

function launch(code){

}

/* tteok - detailed pieces + real impact + level patterns */
function playTteok(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene tteokSceneV9"><div class="tteokAwning"></div><div class="tteokShopSign">1884 전통 떡집</div><div class="backShelf"><div class="tteokTray" style="left:7%;right:54%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokTray" style="left:54%;right:7%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="left:11%;top:36px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="left:25%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="left:39%;top:37px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="right:36%;top:35px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="right:22%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="right:9%;top:37px"></div></div><div class="marketCounter"></div><div class="malletShadowV9"></div><div class="mortarWrap"><div class="mortar"></div><div class="dough" id="dough"></div></div><div class="mortarImpactV9" id="impact"></div><div class="tteokHammer" id="mallet"><div class="woodHammerHead"></div><div class="woodHammerHandle"></div><div class="hammerGrip"></div></div><div class="rhythmTarget" id="target"></div><div class="rhythmRing" id="ring"></div><img class="tteokMascotV9" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="tteokSpeed" id="tteokSpeed">속도 ×1.00</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">연속 성공 COMBO · 5콤보마다 강한 피드백!</div><div class="feverWrap"><div class="feverFill" id="feverFill"></div></div><div class="feverText" id="feverText">찰기 0%</div><div class="tteokGrade" id="grade"></div><button class="tteokHitButton" id="hitBtn">쿵! 떡메 내리치기</button>`;

 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,raf,prev=performance.now();
 let phase=0,combo=0,fever=0,feverTime=0,level=1;

 const ring=$('#ring'),mallet=$('#mallet'),dough=$('#dough'),
       grade=$('#grade'),impact=$('#impact'),scene=$('.tteokSceneV9'),
       target=$('#target');

 // 판정 구간은 레벨/콤보와 무관하게 끝까지 동일.
 const PERFECT_WINDOW=.10;
 const GREAT_WINDOW=.25;
 const GOOD_WINDOW=.46;

 // 난이도 상승은 오직 수축 속도만 변화.
 // LEVEL + COMBO가 오르면 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴이 점점 빨라진다.
 function speedNow(){
  return .78 + (level-1)*.10 + Math.min(1.30, combo*.045);
 }

 function hud(){
  $('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;
  $('#feverFill').style.width=fever+'%';
  $('#feverText').textContent=feverTime>0?`🔥 FEVER ${feverTime.toFixed(1)}s`:`찰기 ${Math.floor(fever)}%`;
  $('#tteokSpeed').textContent=`속도 ×${(speedNow()/.78).toFixed(2)}`;
 }

 function nextBeat(){
  phase=0;
  // 언제나 같은 초록 타깃, 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴.
  target.style.borderColor='#53be6a';
 }

 function impactFx(q){
  mallet.classList.add('strike');
  dough.classList.remove('hit');void dough.offsetWidth;dough.classList.add('hit');
  impact.classList.remove('show');void impact.offsetWidth;impact.classList.add('show');
  scene.classList.remove('impact');void scene.offsetWidth;scene.classList.add('impact');

  let mr=$('.mortar').getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<(q==='perfect'?11:7);i++){
   let ln=document.createElement('div');
   ln.className='impactLineV9';
   ln.style.left=(mr.left-sr.left+mr.width/2+Math.random()*90-45)+'px';
   ln.style.top=(mr.top-sr.top+25)+'px';
   ln.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.random()*120-60}deg)`;
   s.appendChild(ln);setTimeout(()=>ln.remove(),340);
  }
  tone('thump');
  buzz(q==='perfect'?[50,18,75]:[35,14,48]);
  setTimeout(()=>mallet.classList.remove('strike'),125);
 }

 function hit(){
  if(!alive)return;

  // 링은 항상 바깥(2.75) → 중앙(1.0)으로만 수축.
  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  const d=Math.abs(scale-1);

  let pts=0,label='MISS',color='#d84a43',gain=-9,q='miss';

  if(d<PERFECT_WINDOW){
   pts=58;label='PERFECT!';color='#ff9c00';combo++;gain=22;q='perfect';tone('perfect');
  }else if(d<GREAT_WINDOW){
   pts=36;label='GREAT!';color='#62b64d';combo++;gain=14;q='great';tone('good');
  }else if(d<GOOD_WINDOW){
   pts=18;label='GOOD';color='#4e9ad1';combo++;gain=7;q='good';tone('good');
  }else{
   combo=0;tone('bad');softShake();
  }

  let mult=feverTime>0?2:1;
  pts=(pts+Math.min(35,combo*3))*mult;
  score+=pts;
  fever=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,fever+gain));

  if(fever>=100&&feverTime<=0){
   feverTime=5;
   tone('clear');
   particles(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,'🔥',12);
  }

  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  grade.textContent=feverTime>0&&pts>0?label+' ×2':label;
  grade.style.color=color;
  if(pts>0&&combo>=2){
   showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');
   if(combo%5===0){tone('perfect');buzz([16,7,28])}
  }
  grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');

  impactFx(q);
  level=updateLevel('tteok',score,level);
  nextBeat();
  hud();
 }
